text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card (24.1% vs 1.5% expected, risk-adjusted score 13.41, z 3.71, 93% low-complexity, 3 of 3 documented 99215 below billed, 1 of 20 no lab). The caution is appropriate and the next steps are concrete. However, several narrative claims are not supported by the packet, and one example is internally inconsistent. These errors would make an investigator redo some of the checking.","problems":["Example C0102232 is described as 'aged 65 with 1 chronic condition (obesity)', but the card lists it as age 57 with obesity (65 is a different claim, C0102096/C0102161). The age is misstated.","The narrative says the sampled examples include 'back pain, abdominal pain, rash, UTI and URI (C0102078, C0102090, C0102167)'. The card shows C0102078=M54.50 back pain, C0102090=R10.9 abdominal pain, C0102167=J06.9 URI. No rash dx (R21 is on other claims) or UTI is among the three cited, so the claim-to-description fit is loose.","The summary says 'the code rule check also flags the pooled documentation result as not lopsided', but no such rule check appears in the packet. This is an unsupported claim.","The summary says 'The 99213 and 99214 charts largely supported their billed levels', but 1 of 19 99214 was below billed and the 99214 example C0102322 was low MDM. The phrase 'little sign of cloned notes' is an overreach from a single lab-line check.","The next-step wording is partly generic, and the summary does not clearly flag that the 99215 documentation sample is only 3 charts, which it mentions only briefly. Also 'against 0% for comparison providers' is correct but the example list leans on three claims without a cleaner mapping."]}
